verification.intro1: Here is your verification code to finish creating your Lien Parental account.
verification.intro2: Enter it in the app to confirm your email address.
verification.expires: This code expires in {minutes} minutes. If you can't find it, check your spam folder.

welcome.subject: Welcome to Lien Parental
welcome.intro1: Your Lien Parental account is ready. You can now keep your journal, organize the custody
welcome.intro2: schedule and store your important documents in your vault.
welcome.bullet1: Record exchanges and important moments, dated and time-stamped.
welcome.bullet2: Share a clear calendar with the other parent.
welcome.bullet3: Prepare your letters and files from templates.
welcome.closing: We are happy to support you.
welcome.preheader: Your Lien Parental account is ready.
welcome.title: Welcome to Lien Parental

newLogin.subject: New sign-in to your Lien Parental account
newLogin.intro: We detected a new sign-in to your Lien Parental account. If it was you, no action is needed.
newLogin.secureAfter: we will help you revoke active sessions and change your password.
newLogin.title: New sign-in detected

securityChange.notYou: Wasn't you? Secure your account right away: change your password and sign out other devices.
securityChange.footer: Security alerts are always sent, whatever your preferences.

invoice.subject: Your Lien Parental receipt
invoice.intro: We confirm that we have received your payment. Thank you for your trust.
invoice.details: Your detailed invoice is available via the button below. You can download it as a PDF from the page hosted by Stripe.
invoice.footerLead: For any billing question, write to us at
invoice.title: Payment receipt

paymentFailed.intro2: (expired card, limit reached or refused by your bank, for example).

paymentFailed.preheader: The payment of {amount} did not go through.

subscriptionCanceled.ended: Your Premium subscription has ended. Your account has returned to the free plan.

subscriptionCanceled.preheaderEnded: Your account has returned to the free plan.
